description: Edit any video into a captioned showcase — transcribe (any language, defaults to large-v3), present a transcript_review.txt for user approval BEFORE rendering, then build a HyperFrames composition with liquid-glass caption pills, liquid blob background, liquid morph wipes, and optional behind-subject text. Use when editing, captioning, or adding subtitles to video files. Supports English, Hebrew, and any Whisper-supported language. Renders both 16:9 and 9:16 from the SAME 16:9 source — vertical mode uses a centered footage strip with a blurred backdrop + liquid blobs and a vertical-tuned caption pill. THE PIPELINE PAUSES FOR USER APPROVAL on the transcript before final render. Pairs with hyperframes, hyperframes-cli, hyperframes-registry, and yuv-design-system skills.
